comments.text:
ROOT CAUSE CORRECTION (after deeper dig):

This is NOT a per-agent-config-fallback bug. ALL agent spawns fail in this environment, including configured ones (verified by spawning 'rush' which is configured to Haiku 4.5 — same TypeError).

Real cause: Two different pi-coding-agent packages coexist in memory:
  - HOST (running pi binary): @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 0.75.3
  - BUNDLED IN TAU: @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent 0.62.0 (devDependency in extensions/tau/package.json)

Tau's worker (extensions/tau/src/agent/worker/lifecycle.ts:1-10) imports createAgentSession from @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent. That AgentSession class (v0.62.0) calls this._modelRegistry.getApiKey(this.model) at agent-session.js:690, 1072, 1283, 1469, 2305.

But ctx.modelRegistry is provided by the HOST (v0.75.3). In v0.75.3, ModelRegistry.getApiKey(model) was renamed to ModelRegistry.getApiKeyAndHeaders(model): Promise<ResolvedRequestAuth>. So the method does not exist on the registry instance the bundled AgentSession receives.

Other ModelRegistry methods (find, getAvailable, getApiKeyForProvider, isUsingOAuth, registerProvider, unregisterProvider, authStorage, refresh) still exist with same signatures in both versions.

Verified by:
- diff <(grep getApiKey @mariozechner/.../model-registry.d.ts) <(grep getApiKey @earendil-works/.../model-registry.d.ts)
- agent.spawn(rush) returns same TypeError as agent.spawn(finder).

Scope of proper fix: migrate ALL @mariozechner/pi-* imports in extensions/tau/src to @earendil-works/pi-*. That is 111 import statements across ~50 files. Other API changes between v0.62.0 and v0.75.3 will surface (e.g., index.d.ts diff shows ModelInfo, RpcClient, AgentSessionRuntime added; codingTools/readOnlyTools/bashTool runtime exports removed in favor of factory functions; ToolExecutionMode added; loadProjectContextFiles added).
